data.name: Over Tooned
data.detailed_description:
Over Tooned - An anime flavored GenX styled arcade racing game. The game is designed to be jump and go. Now with 501 vehicles with more on the way soon. We are starting with 30 race tracks (more to be added in future updates) and 10 explore tracks 5 Outdoor Adventure and 5 City Adventure (Again more to be added in the future updates). All tracks and explore modes are randomly selected.

Just for fun we have include an Emoji System.

The game controls are defaulted to the keyboard, please see the settings menu to see the supported controller options (ones that we have tested and know work) other controllers may be supported but have not been tested.

Vehicles are unlocked via Racing to gain race points or Collecting Rubber Ducks in the Adventure modes. Race Tracks have moving ramps which are decided per difficulty level. 

There are over 200 songs in all types of genres. 

There are 731 computer controlled AI Racers. Each computer controlled AI Racer has a learning mode meaning they get better every time they race. Each computer controlled AI Racer has an emotional mode. Each computer controlled AI Racer has a relationship mode with every other Racer and the Player. The computer controlled AI Racers do not have Rubber Banding so if they wreck they have to catch up or get passed. Over Tooned features and automatic mode for the AI racers - we included this so that you can test out the different difficulty modes before you race them and see if that is the difficulty mode you want to race (and also just so you can relax and just watch racing if you want).

There are 4 difficulty modes: Easy (Lowest speeds and better control), least amount of ramps, Standard (the default set) usually 2 or 3 ramps per track, Psycho (much higher speeds and acceleration) more ramps, and Madness (Insane speeds and acceleration - we do not recommend playing this mode unless you are an elite Racer) most amount of ramps.

Adventure modes for Outdoor and City have been included for people who like to drive but not necessarily into racing. In these modes you find Rubber Ducks to collect and Hidden areas to get the race points to unlock the vehicles. 

The vehicles have a custom 1990s style Anime type shader. The GUI has a custom 1980's style cartoon type shader. 

Over Tooned features a Streamer Mode and since Over Tooned also features an automatic race system for the computer controlled AI racers a Streamer can take a break and have active game play going without needing to touch anything.

Over Tooned is a GenX style arcade racing game done with a more modern style. We tried to make the game as easy to use as possible. There is no DLC and nothing else to buy all updates will be free.

data.short_description: Over Tooned is a family friendly arcade racing game in the style of Generation X arcades. Controls are easy to learn and the cars are easy to master.
